title: TransportCommand
description: Arguments for the transport invoke commands (transport_play, transport_stop, transport_seek, get_transport_state). play/stop/get take no arguments; seek takes this payload.

command.description: Which transport command this payload accompanies.

positionSamples.description: Seek target as an absolute offset from project start, in samples at the project sample rate (see project.schema.json#/properties/sampleRate). Required when command == "seek".
